corpus.declared_filter: human cells with disease == normal and suspension_type != na
corpus.inventory_granularity: versioned CELLxGENE Census; the exact weekly build is no longer publicly listed and the adjacent LTS 2023-05-15 release is not substituted

crosswalk_scope.scope_limit: This classifies every registered cell-state source by timing and explicit continual-supervision identity. Exact archived Census membership remains unresolved for sources public on or before 2023-05-08. It does not cover bulk or other tasks.

rules.continual_supervision: Any Tabula Sapiens evaluation source is continual_seen for scgpt_continual even when it is merely encoder_seen for scgpt_whole_human.
rules.post_cutoff: A source first public after 2023-05-08 is clean_declared for whole-human unless another training declaration names it.
rules.pre_cutoff: A source public on or before 2023-05-08 remains unknown until exact archived Census membership is rederived; a later Census release is not accepted as a substitute.
